Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Chambliss
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/19/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 49 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of any county, municipality, or authority by an undetermined amount to repair or replace a private sewer lateral, deemed to constitute a public purpose by resolution of the local governing authority. However, this increase in obligations would be offset by the recovery of the actual costs of such repair or replacement by prorating the utility bill of the owner of the private sewer lateral.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government

Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Chambliss
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/02/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 49 as introduced could increase the obligations of counties, municipalities, and authorities, by an undetermined amount, to repair or replace a private sewer lateral deemed a public purpose or to transfer public funds to a property owner to repair or replace a private sewer lateral deemed a public purpose. However, this bill authorizes the counties, municipalities or authorities to recover the amount of any transfer or the actual cost of repair or replacement (whichever is greater), by prorating the amount on the utility bill of the owner of the private sewer lateral.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
